'''Hibbertopterus peachi''' is an [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] arthropod (specifically a [[wikipedia:Eurypterid|Eurypterid]]) from the [[wikipedia:Devonian|Devonian]] era, found in [[temperate]] freshwater or brackish [[lake]]s and [[river]]s. As with all real-world extinct creatures, their spawning depends on settings chosen during world generation.

Despite their size (almost as big as a [[dwarf]]), they are not butcherable or fishable, although they have the {{token|COOKABLE_LIVE|creature}} token. A baby Hibbertopterus peachi is called a ''juvenile''.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] hibbertopterus peachi for their ''broad heads''.
